scope: planning candidate inventory; no production manifest or dependency adoption
review_status: engineering evidence recorded; external review owner-waived for M0 by ADR-0017; candidate-level adoption authority remains absent
definition_of_done_scope: M0 planning artifact only under ADR-0017 owner waiver

disposition_semantics.approve: Exact source may be proposed for a production manifest only after every technical, security, legal, and product gate passes.
disposition_semantics.defer: Candidate remains an evaluation input, but missing identity, evidence, review, or runtime gates prohibit adoption.
disposition_semantics.reject: The exact evaluated source or platform build must not be adopted; a different exact version is a new candidate and requires a fresh dossier.

candidates.name: Tokio
candidates.replacement: Another reviewed async runtime or a narrower executor; replacement is costly because drivers and cancellation ownership depend on runtime semantics.
blockers: No production runtime supervision, bounded task admission, shutdown, or leak contract exists.
No production manifest, final notices, or independent legal/security review exists.
Binary-size contribution was not isolated from either spike stack.

candidates.name: tokio-postgres stack
candidates.role: PostgreSQL protocol driver and rustls connector
candidates.replacement: A separately tested sqlx-postgres or libpq-based connector behind the adapter port; no alternative is presumed safe.
blockers: The upstream codec buffers a complete backend frame before product admission limits apply.
Request admission uses an unbounded channel unless the adapter proves a pre-submission bound.
Upstream SQL, parameter, and notice logging needs an enforced deny/redaction policy.
Credential copies are not end-to-end zeroized and legal review is pending.

candidates.name: mysql_async

license.candidate_level_posture: MIT OR Apache-2.0 reported upstream; exact-version files and transitives not reviewed

candidates.replacement: Another reviewed Rust driver, approved native client, or defer MySQL/MariaDB support.
blockers: No exact version, checksum, feature set, lock graph, advisory snapshot, arm64 build, auth matrix, cancellation evidence, or size measurement exists.
MariaDB divergence and TLS/auth-plugin behavior remain untested.
Legal and maintenance-owner reviews are pending.

candidates.name: rusqlite

license.candidate_level_posture: MIT reported upstream; exact-version files and SQLite linkage choice not reviewed

candidates.replacement: System SQLite C API, a different reviewed wrapper, or keep SQLite engine support deferred.
blockers: No exact crate/source/checksum or system-versus-bundled SQLite decision exists.
No unsafe-boundary audit, bounded blocking-lane test, arm64 build, advisory scan, or size measurement exists.
Legal review is pending.

candidates.name: rustls ecosystem
candidates.replacement: Platform TLS or another adapter-specific TLS stack after the same trust and hostile-server matrix.
blockers: No reviewed platform-root bridge or per-connection custom-CA representation exists.
No cross-driver TLS conformance, release binary-size isolation, or final transitive notices review exists.
Exact production crypto provider and legal approval are pending.

candidates.name: russh
candidates.replacement: Evaluate separately pinned exact russh 0.62.5, a different exact immutable candidate, or another SSH architecture only by rerunning every ADR-0012 gate; otherwise ship without SSH.
blockers: Fresh upstream advisory GHSA-m65r-rprj-r5rg explicitly includes 0.62.4.
Seven frozen runtime rows, password policy, agent failure modes, connector trap, cleanup, Keychain/FFI, distribution, minimum-host, and soak evidence remain incomplete.
RustSec/cargo-deny did not surface the fresh repository advisory, proving that one scanner is insufficient.

candidates.name: macOS system OpenSSH

license.posture: OS-provided multi-file OpenSSH/Apple notices require final review

candidates.replacement: A separately reviewed in-process implementation or a future Apple build with source/backport proof and a no-shell lifecycle design.
blockers: The tested project build predates the source-reviewed OpenSSH 10.4 client rekey fix floor.
Native ProxyJump/-J constructs a shell-executed ProxyCommand and violates the no-shell invariant.
Typed errors, credential transport, process cleanup, sandbox, and no-direct fallback are unproven.

candidates.name: ssh2/libssh2
candidates.role: Rust binding and vendored C SSH candidate

license.declared: MIT OR Apache-2.0 for Rust crates; vendored notices require review

candidates.replacement: A fresh upstream source carrying all current fixes or another SSH implementation; DataForge will not maintain a private security fork.
blockers: The exact vendored source omits current upstream pre-authentication memory-safety fixes.
Fail-closed host verification is application-optional and synchronous cancellation/multi-hop lifecycle remain unproven.

candidates.name: GRDB
candidates.replacement: Direct SQLite C API or another reviewed Swift wrapper behind the persistence port.
blockers: Full Xcode/XCTest, signed Data Protection Keychain integration, realistic product-size/performance, minimum-host, and long-soak evidence are missing.
Final notices, legal review, and independent dependency/security approval are pending.

candidates.name: tree-sitter runtime and SQL grammars

license.candidate_level_posture: Runtime reports MIT; every grammar and generated source needs a separate exact review

candidates.replacement: TextKit highlighting plus an adapter-owned safety parser; a permissive grammar can never be the sole safety classifier.
blockers: No exact runtime/grammar set, checksums, licenses, fuzz corpus, arm64 build, size, or maintenance owner exists.
Safety-critical SQL classification cannot depend on an unvalidated highlighting grammar.

candidates.name: SQLx

license.candidate_level_posture: MIT OR Apache-2.0 reported upstream; exact-version files and feature graph not reviewed

candidates.replacement: Keep driver-per-adapter strategy and compare exact sqlx-postgres/libpq only against the frozen hostile-server matrix.
blockers: No exact version, minimal features, checksum, lock graph, advisory/license result, arm64 build, hostile-frame cap, cancellation, transaction, or size evidence exists.
It is not selected as a generic lowest-common-denominator driver.

candidates.name: Sparkle
candidates.replacement: Manual verified delivery or another separately reviewed updater; a custom updater is not authorized.
blockers: No Developer ID/notarized framework integration, pre-extraction host validation, real download/install/relaunch/interruption/rollback, or key-rotation evidence exists.
Final bundled notices, legal review, product size, and independent release-security approval are pending.

candidates.name: Sentry Cocoa

license.candidate_level_posture: SDK reports MIT; hosted-service terms, DPA, privacy, and exact artifact notices are separate

candidates.replacement: Local previewable diagnostics with no upload, or a later reviewed opt-in provider.
blockers: No exact version/source/checksum, payload allowlist, no-network default test, DSN/secret model, retention/deletion policy, privacy/DPA/legal review, arm64 build, or size evidence exists.
Telemetry and crash upload must remain off by default.
